title: Review (Supported): on fresh seed 3, k=2 gives no bodies from noise, lam_f=1.0 gives dividing rods that travel at most 1.9 body lengths (claim world 1.8 on the same seed), and planted k=3 droplets become static small bodies
summary: labkit runs of c15's nematic-fuelcell claim world on seed 3 (128^2, T=1000), one parameter changed at a time as in the finding. k=2 from noise: 0 components at every frame, 0 nucleations. lam_f=1.0 from noise: 25 rods, 15 persistent splits, generation 5, 8 tracks moving >= 1 body length, max 1.9 body lengths. Unchanged claim world (k=1.5, lam_f=0.5) on the same seed: 26 rods, 7 persistent splits, generation 3, max 1.8 body lengths. Planted round droplets (world_plant.py) at k=3: 5 bodies, max 1.0 body length, 0 persistent splits. No setting reaches >= 3 body lengths, so the negative replicates.

observations.M: negative replicated: max body lengths 0.0 (k=2, no bodies), 1.9 (lam_f=1.0), 1.0 (planted k=3) against 1.8 for the claim world on seed 3 (rerun/*/seed3/FACTS.md)

controls_run.M: rerun/base/seed3 (claim world, unchanged parameters) alongside the k=2, lam_f=1.0 and planted k=3 arms

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed per arm; k=3 and k=5 from noise and planted k=1.5 not rerun. On seed 3 the claim world itself does not swim (1.8 body lengths), so this seed cannot show a loss of motility, only its absence.
